rulings.restated: Enter the amount from sd helper "Capital gain or limited capital loss for Form 1040 line 7a".
rulings.model: The form says only 'Capital gain or (loss). Attach Schedule D if required.' The text given does not include the wording of Schedule D lines 16 and 21 or the line 7a instructions, so the choice between line 16 and line 21 cannot be checked. It also cannot be confirmed that capital gain distributions reported without Schedule D reach line 16.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. The Schedule D helper carries line 16 when it is a gain and line 21 when line 16 is a loss (f1040sd p. 2, line 16: "If line 16 is a gain, enter the amount from line 16 on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 7a"; line 21: "If line 16 is a loss, enter here and on Form 1040, 1040-SR, or 1040-NR, line 7a, the smaller of: the loss on line 16; or ($3,000), or if married filing separately, ($1,500)"). When Schedule D is not required (i1040gi p. 31, line 7a, Exception 1) the only Schedule D entry is line 13, so line 16 equals the Form 1099-DIV box 2a total that line 7a takes directly. No change to the data.
